recentItems.title: Destruction in Lebanon: Israeli military razes southern towns
recentItems.description:
Satellite images and footage filmed by Al Jazeera reveal the scale of destruction across Israeli-occupied southern Lebanon.

Homes, infrastructure and places of historical and cultural significance have been damaged or destroyed, raising concerns about what displaced residents will have left to return to.

Israel says its buffer zone is necessary to protect its northern towns, but the destruction raises questions about the future of communities in southern Lebanon.

As Israel prepares for elections, the impact of its policies on neighbouring countries remains in focus.

Al Jazeera’s Ali Hashem reports on the destruction in southern Lebanon.

recentItems.title: Israeli lockdown in Hebron displaces 200 Palestinian families, restricts movement across West Bank
recentItems.description:
Up to 200 Palestinian families have been forcibly displaced from their homes in Hebron amid an Israeli military lockdown. Residents fled with few belongings, raising fears of prolonged displacement and home demolitions.

Road closures and checkpoints have isolated communities across the occupied West Bank, restricting movement and access to healthcare.

Al Jazeera’s Noor Odeh reports from Birzeit.

recentItems.title: Argentina identifies eight more victims of military dictatorship at former detention centre
recentItems.description:
A federal judge in Argentina has announced the identification of eight more victims of the country's military dictatorship, which ruled from 1976 to 1983.

Forensic scientists have been excavating the site of a notorious former detention centre since last year, working to identify victims of the dictatorship and uncover evidence of past abuses.

Al Jazeera’s Joel Evans reports.
